name: Express Entry (FSW / CEC)
shortDescription: Points-based visa favoring workers with strong English scores and university degrees.

requirements.description: At least 1 year of continuous skilled work experience.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Get 1 year of skilled work experience

requirements.description: Good English test score (IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 72+).
requirements.resolutionActionName: Score at least 6.0 on IELTS (or 72 on TOEFL)

requirements.description: High English test score (IELTS 7.0+ or TOEFL 95+).
requirements.resolutionActionName: Raise IELTS to 7.0+ (or TOEFL to 95+)

requirements.description: Bank savings proof (around $10,000+ USD) unless you already have a Canadian job.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Save $10,000 USD to cover moving costs

requirements.description: Bachelor's degree or higher.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Complete a Bachelor's degree

requirements.description: Master's degree or PhD.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Complete a Master's degree

requirements.description: Age between 20 and 29.
Job in tech, engineering, science, or healthcare.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Work in a tech, engineering, or healthcare role

name: Skilled Worker Visa
shortDescription: Work visa requiring a job offer from an approved UK employer and minimum pay.

requirements.description: Must have a job offer and sponsor code from an approved UK employer.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Get a job offer from an approved UK sponsor

requirements.description: Job must pay at least £38,700/year (sometimes less if under 26 or in a shortage role).
requirements.resolutionActionName: Find a role meeting the UK minimum salary rule

requirements.description: At least a basic English test score (IELTS 4.0+ or TOEFL 42+).
requirements.resolutionActionName: Pass an approved English test (IELTS 4.0+)

name: H-1B Specialty Occupation
shortDescription: Work visa where a US employer sponsors you for a specialized job needing a degree.

requirements.description: Requires a job offer from a US employer willing to sponsor your visa.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Get a job offer from a US company willing to sponsor H-1B

requirements.description: Requires at least a Bachelor's degree in a matching field.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Complete a Bachelor's degree

name: DE Rantau Nomad Pass
shortDescription: Remote work visa for tech and digital workers earning a minimum income.

requirements.description: Minimum yearly income of $24,000 USD.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Earn at least $24,000 USD per year in a remote job

requirements.description: Must work in tech, software, or digital fields.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Work in an IT or digital role

name: Skilled Independent Visa (Subclass 189)
shortDescription: Points-based permanent visa for invited workers whose skills Australia needs.

requirements.description: Strong English score (IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 72+).
requirements.resolutionActionName: Pass IELTS with 6.0+ (or TOEFL 72+)

requirements.description: Age under 45 years.

name: EU Blue Card
shortDescription: Work and residence visa for university graduates from outside the EU with a skilled job offer.

requirements.description: A recognized university degree.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Complete a Bachelor's degree

requirements.description: A signed job contract or formal job offer in Germany.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Get a job offer in Germany

name: Digital Nomad Visa
shortDescription: Visa allowing non-EU remote workers and freelancers to live in Spain.

requirements.description: Steady monthly remote income (at least double Spain's minimum wage, ~2,500 EUR/month).
requirements.resolutionActionName: Show remote income of at least ~2,500 EUR/month

name: Golden Visa
shortDescription: Long-term 10-year residence visa for high-earning professionals, investors, and top students.

requirements.description: Monthly salary of at least 30,000 AED (~$8,100 USD) for professionals.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Meet the minimum monthly salary requirement

name: Highly Skilled Professional Visa
shortDescription: Points-based visa for skilled professionals with strong degrees, experience, or high salaries.

requirements.description: At least 70 points on Japan's skilled points check (based on degree, experience, and salary).
requirements.resolutionActionName: Reach 70+ points through experience, degree, or salary

name: Destination Thailand Visa (DTV)
shortDescription: 5-year multiple-entry visa for remote workers and digital nomads.

requirements.description: Bank proof showing at least 500,000 THB (~$14,000 USD) in savings.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Save at least ~$14,000 USD

requirements.description: Proof of $1,500 USD/month remote income or $18,000 USD in savings.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Show proof of remote income or bank savings

name: Estonia Digital Nomad Visa
shortDescription: Lets remote workers live in Estonia for up to 1 year.

requirements.description: Proof of steady remote income around €4,500/month (~$5,000 USD) or enough savings.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Show steady remote work contract or income

name: Quality Migrant Admission Scheme (QMAS)
shortDescription: Points-based visa for skilled professionals—no job offer needed upfront.

requirements.description: Higher university degrees earn significantly more points.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Complete a higher university degree

requirements.description: 5+ years of skilled or specialist work experience.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Gain more skilled work experience

name: Critical Skills Work Visa
shortDescription: Work visa for workers whose job is on South Africa's high-demand skills list.

requirements.description: A university degree matching a high-demand skill area.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Have your degree verified in South Africa (SAQA check)

requirements.description: At least 3 years of work experience after earning your degree.
requirements.resolutionActionName: Gain 3 years of work experience
